newsitem.title: GHANA: Lacklustre Ghana bourse closes little changed.
newsitem.headline: Lacklustre Ghana bourse closes little changed.

text.p: Trading on the Ghana Stock Exchange was low-key on Monday with the share index closing hardly changed and only two equities recording any price change.
The GSE All-Share Index closed a fractional 0.1 point up at 386.18. A total of 25,600 shares changed hands compared 59,860 on Friday.
Of the two stocks that moved, Metalloplastica Ghana Ltd gained 15 cedis to 180 and Pioneer Tobacco Co added one cedi to 221 cedis.
